description: Image Description: A plush toy resembling a blue, rounded character with a simple facial expression—black eyebrows and a small curved mouth—is positioned on a skateboard. The toy has a soft, fuzzy texture and is wearing a small green hat with a gold band, resembling a top hat. It is seated upright on the grip tape of the skateboard, which is placed on a concrete surface.
